-- in --
package main

templ x(items []string) {
	<div>
		<span></span>

	</div>
	if true {
		<span></span>


	}
	for _, item := range items {
		<div>{ item }</div>

	}


}
-- out --
package main

templ x(items []string) {
	<div>
		<span></span>
	</div>
	if true {
		<span></span>
	}
	for _, item := range items {
		<div>{ item }</div>
	}
}
